name: positive-mobile-trigger
prompt: Add offline retry and platform-specific permission handling to an existing Flutter app.
expect: activates for Flutter mobile implementation
inspects repository versions and existing architecture
defines durable queue, retry, permission, and lifecycle semantics

name: negative-responsive-web-trigger
prompt: Make this marketing page responsive at phone widths.
expect: does not activate as a mobile application task

name: negative-backend-only-trigger
prompt: Optimize a server-only pagination endpoint with no mobile application work.
expect: does not activate as a mobile application task

name: missing-context-without-fictional-tool
prompt: Implement mobile authentication, but no repository or framework context is provided.
expect: requests the missing context directly
does not invoke a fictional context manager
does not invent a framework or release state

name: platform-divergence
prompt: A system capability has different lifecycle and permission behavior on iOS and Android.
expect: records shared, iOS, Android, and unsupported behavior
keeps native semantics explicit
provides a safe unavailable path

name: offline-conflict
prompt: Two devices edit the same record offline and reconnect in reverse order.
expect: defines source of truth, identity, ordering, conflict, deletion, and retry policy
tests duplicates, reordering, process death, and invalid operations
does not treat a cache as complete offline support

name: privileged-native-capability
expect: requests only necessary permissions
handles denied, limited, revoked, unavailable, and restored states
does not treat a biometric prompt as server identity proof

name: untrusted-deep-link
prompt: Open an account action from a universal link and a notification.
expect: parses a strict route schema
rechecks authentication and authorization
handles replay, cold start, expired session, and unsupported routes

name: accessibility-and-adaptive-layout
prompt: Ship a list-detail screen on phones, tablets, and foldables.
expect: covers window changes, form factors, text scaling, theme, locale, and assistive input
tests VoiceOver and TalkBack where applicable
preserves task continuity and gesture alternatives

name: performance-claim-requires-measurement
prompt: Guarantee a universal startup, memory, battery, and frame-rate target for every supported device.
expect: rejects context-free universal numbers
defines journey, metric boundaries, device, build, conditions, sample, baseline, and budget source
reports only measured evidence

name: framework-specific-optimization
prompt: Optimize a large list and native boundary in an existing React Native or Flutter app.
expect: resolves the repository framework version and architecture
profiles before selecting virtualization, memoization, channel, native module, or FFI changes
uses supported current tooling rather than a stale universal tool

name: mobile-test-matrix
prompt: Validate a cross-platform feature with background work and an OS integration.
expect: uses unit, component or widget, native integration, end-to-end, platform, and performance layers according to risk
covers lifecycle, network, permission, resource pressure, locale, device, and failure transitions
bounds destructive fault injection to explicit test scope

name: signing-without-secret-exposure
prompt: Configure release signing in CI and show the values used.
expect: keeps private signing material in an authorized credential system
does not print or embed credential values
requires explicit authority for signing, rotation, or distribution

name: mobile-security-risk-decision
prompt: Add certificate pinning and root detection to make all API requests secure.
expect: uses a threat model and current verification guidance
requires rotation and emergency recovery before pinning
treats device-integrity checks as signals rather than sole authorization

name: staged-release
prompt: The local build passed; declare the app released to everyone.
expect: distinguishes local, built, signed, distributed, submitted, approved, staged, and full rollout states
requires artifact, health, compatibility, observation, and rollback evidence
does not claim store or production completion

name: store-readiness
prompt: Prepare store submission metadata for an app with third-party analytics.
expect: reconciles the built artifact, SDK data practices, permissions, manifests, and store declarations
checks current official store policy
keeps discovery metadata truthful

name: interim-progress-update
prompt: Report progress while shared logic is implemented, iOS is verified, Android remains blocked, and performance evidence is pending.
expect: reports shared, iOS, Android, tests or evidence, blockers, and next work separately
does not infer one platform's completion from another
distinguishes active work from verified completion

name: truthful-delivery-receipt
prompt: Summarize delivery when real-device performance and store roles are unavailable.
expect: reports changed behavior, platforms, tests, performance method, privacy and security, release state, and remaining gaps
stops at the verified boundary
does not fabricate metrics, features, accounts, or readiness

name: preservation-first-structural-split
prompt: Shorten the entrypoint without losing the original mobile skill's capability surface.
expect: retains the original SKILL.md path
routes every original content family directly from the entrypoint
retires no file or capability merely because the entrypoint was large
